zh-CN: 确认发布
en-US: Confirm publication

zh-CN: 发布后该公告将对读者可见，确定发布吗？
en-US: Publishing will make this announcement visible to readers. Publish it?

zh-CN: 确认撤回
en-US: Confirm withdrawal

zh-CN: 撤回后该公告将不再对读者展示。历史版本保留；重新发布须建立修订草稿并重新提交。确定撤回吗？
en-US: Withdrawing hides this announcement from readers and preserves its historical version. Publishing again requires a revision draft and a new submission. Withdraw it?

zh-CN: 建立修订草稿
en-US: Create revision draft

zh-CN: 将基于历史版本建立可编辑草稿，保存不会直接发布。确定建立吗？
en-US: Create an editable draft from the historical version? Saving does not publish it.

zh-CN: 请刷新后重试，操作标识缺失。
en-US: Refresh and retry: the operation identity is missing.

zh-CN: 包含不可直接修改的公告字段，请刷新后重试。
en-US: Protected announcement fields cannot be changed directly.

zh-CN: 公告发布尚未启用：需要先完成受众授权与可靠分发接入。
en-US: Announcement publication is not enabled until audience authorization and reliable delivery are installed.

zh-CN: 公告不存在或无权访问。
en-US: The announcement does not exist or is not accessible.

zh-CN: 当前状态不能执行此操作，请刷新查看最新状态。
en-US: This action is unavailable in the current state. Refresh to see the latest state.

zh-CN: 此公告已有历史版本，不能删除。
en-US: This announcement has historical versions and cannot be deleted.

zh-CN: 公告输入不符合要求。
en-US: The announcement input is invalid.

zh-CN: 公告标题最多256个字符。
en-US: The announcement title must not exceed 256 characters.

zh-CN: 请通过公告受控操作完成修改。
en-US: Use an authorized announcement command to make changes.

zh-CN: 附件不可用，请确认已上传完成且属于当前租户。
en-US: The attachment is unavailable. Check that its upload is finalized in this tenant.

zh-CN: 免审发布需要选择免审模式并填写免审原因。
en-US: Choose exemption mode and provide an exemption reason.

zh-CN: 发布前请补全公告标题和正文。
en-US: Complete the announcement title and content before publication.

zh-CN: 预约时间必须晚于当前时间，请重新选择。
en-US: Choose a scheduled time in the future.

zh-CN: 有效期不能早于发布时间或知悉截止时间，请调整。
en-US: The expiry must cover publication and the acknowledgement deadline.

zh-CN: 没有符合授权规则的接收人，请调整通知对象。
en-US: No authorized recipients matched. Update the audience.

zh-CN: 审批依据尚未就绪，请核对审批进展。
en-US: Approval authority is not ready. Check approval progress.

zh-CN: 发布授权已变化，请重新核对范围并提交。
en-US: Publication authorization changed. Review the audience and submit again.

zh-CN: 通知桥接尚未启用，请联系租户管理员完成配置后再发布。
en-US: The notification bridge is disabled. Ask the tenant administrator to enable it before publication.

zh-CN: 取消发布安排
en-US: Cancel release

zh-CN: 取消后不会发布，冻结版本和历史记录仍会保留。确定取消吗？
en-US: The release will stop. Its frozen version and history will remain. Cancel it?

zh-CN: 提交公告审批
en-US: Submit announcement approval

zh-CN: 提交后将冻结正文、附件和通知设置；审批通过后按发布安排执行。确定提交吗？
en-US: Content, attachments and notification settings will be frozen. Approval will authorize the configured release. Submit now?

zh-CN: 当前租户要求公告审批，请选择审批发布。
en-US: This tenant requires announcement approval. Select approval before publishing.

zh-CN: 请在通知设置中选择审批发布。
en-US: Select approval in notification settings.

zh-CN: 请选择可用审批流程，或由租户管理员设置默认流程。
en-US: Select an available approval workflow or ask the tenant administrator to configure a default.

zh-CN: 审批提供方已变更，请由管理员核对组合安装版本。
en-US: The approval provider changed. Ask an administrator to verify the installed composition.

zh-CN: 请填写撤销审批的原因。
en-US: Enter a reason for withdrawing the approval.

zh-CN: 排除申请人后没有有效审批人，请联系流程管理员。
en-US: No eligible approver remains after excluding the applicant. Contact the workflow administrator.

zh-CN: 指定审批人的成员身份已失效，请联系流程管理员。
en-US: A designated approver is no longer an active member. Contact the workflow administrator.

zh-CN: 审批结果同步异常，请核对流程服务和当前权限后恢复。
en-US: Approval synchronization is blocked. Verify the workflow service and current permissions before resuming.

zh-CN: 审批流程执行异常，请联系流程管理员处理。
en-US: The approval workflow requires attention from the workflow administrator.

zh-CN: 该公告已失效或你不在本版本接收范围内。
en-US: This version is no longer available to your current membership.

zh-CN: 公告版本已变化，请刷新后再操作。
en-US: The announcement version changed. Refresh before continuing.

zh-CN: 本版本不要求确认知悉。
en-US: This version does not require acknowledgement.

zh-CN: 请先打开并阅读公告正文，再确认知悉。
en-US: Open the announcement content before acknowledging it.

zh-CN: 请打开公告并使用“确认已知悉”，不能直接完成或忽略此待办。
en-US: Open the announcement and acknowledge it to complete this task.

zh-CN: 确认已知悉
en-US: Acknowledge this announcement

zh-CN: 确认你已阅读并知悉本版本公告。系统将保留首次确认时间。
en-US: Confirm that you have read and understood this version. Your first acknowledgement time will be preserved.

zh-CN: 该公告版本的封存统计暂不可用。
en-US: Sealed statistics are unavailable for this announcement version.

zh-CN: 统计快照已过期，请刷新统计后重试。
en-US: This statistics snapshot has expired. Refresh statistics and try again.

zh-CN: 本版本接收人数超过当前统计容量，请联系管理员。
en-US: This version exceeds the configured statistics capacity. Contact an administrator.

zh-CN: 历史迁移公告缺少原始阅读依据，请修订并重新发布后使用催办。
en-US: Historical migration has no original reading evidence. Publish a reviewed revision before sending reminders.

zh-CN: 该版本未冻结催办政策，请修订并重新发布。
en-US: This version has no frozen reminder policy. Publish a reviewed revision.

zh-CN: 公告已撤回或失效，无法继续催办。
en-US: This announcement is withdrawn or expired. Reminders are unavailable.

zh-CN: 催办预览已过期或不属于当前身份，请重新预览。
en-US: The reminder preview has expired or belongs to another identity. Preview again.

zh-CN: 自动催办计划无需恢复，请刷新状态。
en-US: The automatic reminder plan is not blocked. Refresh its status.

zh-CN: 尚无已发布的自动催办计划，公告发布后可查看。
en-US: No published reminder plan is available yet. View the plan after publication.

zh-CN: 置顶
en-US: Pin announcement

zh-CN: 仅调整公告列表的置顶排序，不改动已发布正文，也不会重新通知读者。确认置顶？
en-US: Adjust list ordering only. The published content and notification history stay unchanged.

zh-CN: 取消置顶
en-US: Unpin announcement

zh-CN: 取消置顶，不改动已发布正文，也不会重新通知读者。确认取消置顶？
en-US: Remove pinning without changing published content or generating notifications.

zh-CN: 核对审批结果
en-US: Reconcile approval

zh-CN: 将同一审批申请重新排队，从审批服务核对真实结果；不会直接批准公告或新建流程。确认核对？
en-US: Queue the same approval for authoritative result verification. This does not approve or create a new process.

zh-CN: 此发布任务当前不能恢复；请刷新检查任务状态、有效期和执行窗口。
en-US: This publication cannot be retried. Refresh and verify its state, expiry and execution window.

zh-CN: 公告只能使用租户默认审批流程；请先在通知设置中明确选择租户默认审批。
en-US: Announcements must use the tenant default approval workflow. Explicitly select the tenant default in notification settings first.

zh-CN: 受众人数超过当前公告处理容量，发布尚未受理。请缩小范围或联系管理员调整容量。
en-US: The audience exceeds the configured announcement capacity. Publication was not accepted. Reduce the audience or contact an administrator.
